tone: Warm, brief, direct. Short sentences. First names. No corporate filler, no exclamation marks, no 'hope this finds you well'.
principles: Lead with the answer, then the reason if one is needed.
Offer concrete times, never 'sometime next week'.
When redirecting, make the person feel routed, not rejected.
One clear next step at the end.
samples: Dana - good timing. Two questions back at you before we meet: is this about the EMEA plan or NRR? Either way, Tuesday works.
Kyle - thanks for the note. Marcus owns our analytics stack and he's the right first conversation. Copying him here.
Priya - yes, but not Tuesday morning. That block is how the strategy memo gets written. Grab Thursday 2pm.
internal_note_style: Terse operator shorthand. Context first, ask second.
